summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing its shareholder return policy for 2026–2028, targeting a 35–40% return ratio (dividends plus buybacks and cancellation of treasury shares) funded by adjusted net income attributable to controlling interests. The policy is performance-linked and enhances dividend visibility. The plan is subject to board or shareholder approval and may change with market conditions. Watch for actual execution against the target, as the policy is a commitment but not binding.
